purpose: Complete OLMoE online-FP8 counterpart to the r07 BF16 exploration matrix; one run, not independent confirmation
deployment_status_at_preparation: LOCAL_ONLY; deploy and submit only after r08 reaches a successful terminal state
format_semantics: vLLM online FP8 MoE W8A8 quantizes expert weights and MoE GEMM activations; outer model dtype and auto KV remain BF16. Effects are not attributed only to weight compression.
time_policy: Per-stage caps are bounded by the remaining total budget, with 10 seconds reserved for cleanup; timeouts and unrun stages remain explicit. The r07 BF16 matrix took 4118.8 seconds; FP8 duration remains unmeasured.
dependency_policy: FP8 traces -> FP8 native tuning -> both graph identity checks -> full 63-cell graph benchmark. Eager quality needs tuning but not graph success; quality failures do not suppress independent later quality or benchmark stages. Any failed or unrun stage prevents overall COMPLETE.
tuning_policy: Unset inherited VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER for trace/tuning; all later model stages share this run's FP8 native_tuning/tuned_configs. Never use BF16 tuning for FP8.
comparison: Same checkpoint, P128, N2048, maxlen2304 and .35 total memory budget as r07; nine performance arms and all ten quality arms remain unchanged.
energy: Use the existing separate NVML decode integral; each actual window must be >=3 seconds for the energy claim. Shorter windows remain diagnostic in the existing runner; no fixed-length assumption replaces that check.
f6_scope: Synthetic E64/k8 routing policy overhead with counters, including warmed eager thread CPU and captured device timing; not an FP8 expert-GEMM or service result.
rolling_scope: Nine-window B8 plus final B1 path check only, not complete-split PPL and not a test of the split's final short-token window.
statistics: Validation exploration and one fresh performance run per arm; tokens/steps are not independent system repetitions. Natural task quality is handled by the separate task suite.
